name: indo_afro_sunrise
character: An Indo-Afro groove inside a rainforest canopy: the groove and the ambience carry the piece, so the gate keeps every melodic row and adds the immersive and environment rows, and it relaxes nothing.
why: the piece has a figure (bansuri) and a full rhythm section, so `melodic` is the closest shipped type; this profile is the project's own document, and it starts with no row changed

expression._source: this piece's own figures for direction.expression, expression.arousal_order and melody.variety. The melody floors are tighter than the shipped starting values on purpose, and each one is measured on this score (expression_report --project): the bansuri line repeats 50 % of its bars exactly, carries 2.73 bits of interval entropy over 112 notes and spans 19 semitones. So the floors are 55 % / 1.5 bits / 12 semitones - each one met (0.50, 2.73, 19), each one tighter than the shipped 60 % / 1.0 / 7, and none of them a value the piece does not reach. The anchors and the arousal floor are the shipped starting values, unchanged; the arousal order measured +1.00 against the declared section energy.
